page_title: HAM 2-2 BAY | Hamburger SV v Bayern Munich 31/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Harm Osmers is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90+10' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
90+8' Bayern Munich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+5' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) for his blatant foul.
90+4' Bayern Munich failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+3' Daniel Heuer Fernandes (Hamburger) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+2' Bayern Munich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Bayern Munich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.

90' Daniel Heuer Fernandes leaps like a salmon to deny Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
89' The corner is swung in but Bayern Munich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
87' This is a yellow card! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
86' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
86' Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) has tested the patience of referee Harm Osmers and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
85' Merlin Polzin decides to make a substitution. Albert Sambi Lokonga will be replaced by Immanuel Pherai (Hamburger).
85' Substitution. Fabio Vieira is replaced by Robert Glatzel (Hamburger).
80' The attendance for today's match is 57000.
75' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) gets booked for the first time in this match.

75' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) gathers a nice lofted pass just outside the box and attempts to put the ball low into the middle of the goal, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
74' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayern Munich comes to nothing.
73' Here is a change. William Mikelbrencis is going off and Merlin Polzin gives the last tactical orders to Warmed Omari (Hamburger).
73' Substitution. Ransford Konigsdorffer will be replaced by Rayan Philippe (Hamburger).
70' The foul by Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) was seen by Harm Osmers who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
67' Bayern Munich couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Daniel Heuer Fernandes (Hamburger) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
65' Bayern Munich will take a corner kick.
65' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Min-Jae Kim and he is replaced by Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich).
65' A substitution has been made. Serge Gnabry goes off and Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) comes on.
64' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich win a corner kick.
61' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) replaces Bakery Jatta.
57' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
57' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
57' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) commits a rough foul. Harm Osmers stops the game and makes a call.
55' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) earns the yellow card.
53' 2 - 2 Goal! Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) makes the score 2:2 after burying a close-range header in the bottom left corner after a good run and cross by William Mikelbrencis.

51' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) wasted a huge opportunity! He received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a decent shot in from close range. Unfortunately for him, it sailed narrowly wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
51' Harm Osmers has a clear sight and sees a foul from Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich). It's a free kick to Hamburger SV, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

50' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
46' 1 - 2 Goal! Michael Olise shows great vision to find Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Vincent Kompany gives a chance to Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) and Lennart Karl is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+5' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
45+2' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
42' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Joshua Kimmich laid the ball off to Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
39' Hamburger SV take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
38' The free kick from long range, taken by Hamburger SV, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV have been awarded a corner kick.
38' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is penalised for holding. Harm Osmers signals a set piece. Hamburger SV are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
36' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bayern Munich.
34' 1 - 0 Goal! Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Manuel Neuer into the bottom left corner.
32' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
32' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Harm Osmers signals. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Hamburger SV.
31' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
29' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
27' Hamburger SV couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Manuel Neuer (Bayern Munich) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
25' None of the Hamburger SV players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.

24' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Manuel Neuer inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the bottom left corner, but was denied by a great save.
23' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) was quite harsh and Harm Osmers didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
22' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
17' Bayern Munich take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

16' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Bayern Munich will have a corner.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich.

15' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Daniel Heuer Fernandes. Bayern Munich have a corner.

14' Great save! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Daniel Heuer Fernandes.

13' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
10' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
8' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.

6' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he arrows his header just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
6' The ball is out of play. Hamburger SV will have a chance to score from a corner.

5' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Hamburger SV force a corner. They send men into the box.
3' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) commits a foul during an attacking move.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Hamburger SV will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Harm Osmers.
